summary: This is an 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., as depositor for MSWF Commercial Mortgage Trust 2023-2, a CMBS issuing entity. The filing solely reports a change in the special servicer of the Westfarms Mortgage Loan (0.2% of the pool), from Greystone Servicing Company LLC to CWCapital Asset Management LLC, effective July 15, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event is involved. It is a routine asset-level servicing update. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or shareholder impact. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
